description: PM2 integration layer: the pure mapper and the Pm2Client — the only module that imports the pm2 package. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, events, state hub, error tracker). Implements connection + exponential-backoff reconnection, launchBus with the pinned four-channel event->MonitorEvents translation and field-path defense, the intentional-action FIFO token model, the single metrics poll loop that emits metrics:tick, and bounded log-tail reading. Grounded in design.md 'PM2 integration layer', the pinned bus packet contracts, the intentional-action token model, the metrics poll loop (MEDIUM-1), the restart-overlimit disjointness (MEDIUM-3), aggregate semantics, and the error-handling table.
steps: src/pm2/mapper.ts: pure mapProcess(raw): ProcessSnapshot producing the per-NAME aggregate (instances = instance count, cpu/memory summed/representative, pmId/pid = primary instance) with status mapped to ProcStatus. Bus-packet normalizer helpers using the field-path defense: ev = packet.event ?? packet.data?.event, proc = packet.process ?? packet.data?.process; normalize process:exception data via data.stack ?? data.message ?? String(data). Log a one-time warn on a name collision (same name, differing pm_id set in one list). Add src/pm2/mapper.test.ts with recorded pm2.list fixtures, both flat and nested packet layouts, a process:exception packet, and a collision case.

src/pm2/client.ts: Pm2Client implementing the design interface — start() (non-blocking connect + reconnect loop), stop() (disconnect + close bus + clear timers), isConnected(), list(), describe(name), control(action,name) targeting an existing process BY NAME (resolves name->pm_id(s); start=start-a-stopped-process, distinct from startNew), startNew(opts), readLogsTail(name,lines,opts). Wrap all pm2 callback APIs in promisify-style helpers. On disconnect, control short-circuits to {ok:false,code:'PM2_UNAVAILABLE'} without throwing; a pm2-side control error yields {ok:false,code:'PM2_ERROR'}.

In client.ts implement connection + reconnection: pm2.connect on start; on success setConnected(true), initial list(), launchBus; on failure or later disconnect/bus error enter an exponential-backoff loop (1s,2s,4s... cap 30s, +/-20% jitter) retrying indefinitely, first failure warn then subsequent debug, keeping pm2Connected=false. On reconnect re-list, re-attach bus, flip connected true, broadcast.

In client.ts subscribe launchBus to the four channels process:event, process:exception, log:err, log:out and translate per design: online/start -> transition online (no error); restart -> transition + error:captured level restart tagged intentional per token consumption; restart overlimit -> transition errored + error:captured level crash, driving errored ONLY and NOT incrementing the restart-window counter (MEDIUM-3); exit -> error:captured level crash only if no intentional token consumed; stop -> transition stopped, intentional-vs-unexpected via token; delete -> remove from snapshot map (no error); process:exception -> error:captured level crash (normalized message/stack); log:err -> split lines, each emits log:line level error AND feeds ErrorTracker level error; log:out -> split lines, each emits log:line level info (not an error).

In client.ts implement the intentional-action token model: per-process FIFO queue of IntentionToken {kind:'stop'|'restart'|'delete', expiresAt}. On a control call push one token per expected lifecycle event (one per running instance from the current snapshot.instances, fallback 1): stop=>N stop, delete=>N delete, restart/reload=>N restart; start/startNew push none. expiresAt = now + GRACE_MS where GRACE_MS = INTENTIONAL_ACTION_GRACE_MS + the process kill_timeout when describe exposes it. On a stop/exit event drop expired tokens then consume exactly one non-expired FIFO token if present (one token suppresses exactly one event); consuming a restart token marks the emitted restart error intentional:true, else intentional:false; no token => unexpected (crash for exit, eligible for unexpected-stop). Sweep on each consume and on a 30s janitor timer.

In client.ts implement the metrics poll loop (MEDIUM-1): a single setInterval(METRICS_SAMPLE_SEC) started once on first successful connect, cleared on stop(). Each tick calls list(); on transient error skip the tick (no event, debug log, keep last samples); on success call MonitorState.applyPm2List and emit exactly one metrics:tick carrying that ProcessSnapshot[].

In client.ts implement readLogsTail(name,lines,opts): resolve pm_out_log_path/pm_err_log_path via describe, read the trailing `lines` physical lines (bounded end-of-file read; lines clamped <=2000) of the selected stream file(s); tag err-file lines error and out-file lines info; for stream=all merge+sort by embedded/estimated ts (fallback read order); apply level filter then q filter (case-insensitive substring, /regex/ form treated as regex) in memory over that slice. Whole-history search is out of scope.

Add src/pm2/client.test.ts covering the token model with an injected clock and a fake pm2 + fake snapshot providing instances: one-token-per-instance consume, FIFO order, expiry, restart exit->online suppression (restart tagged intentional:true), unexpected stop with no token, and that restart overlimit does not increment the restart counter. Isolate pm2 behind an injectable adapter so the package's real daemon is never needed.
Fix any import/wiring so src builds; do NOT yet wire Pm2Client into src/index.ts beyond what compiles (full bootstrap is FEAT-004).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build compiles with ZERO TypeScript errors (pm2 and @types/node resolve).

npm test passes for src/pm2/mapper.test.ts and src/pm2/client.test.ts including both bus-packet layouts, the process:exception packet, the token model (one-per-instance/FIFO/expiry/restart-suppression), and restart-overlimit NOT counting toward restart-threshold.
control() short-circuits to PM2_UNAVAILABLE when disconnected and never throws; the reconnection loop uses capped backoff with jitter.
The poll loop emits exactly one metrics:tick per successful list and is the only place a metrics timer exists.
Pm2Client is the only module importing the pm2 package (mapper is pure, no I/O).
verification: Run: npm run build  — zero tsc strict errors.
Run: npm test  — mapper and client unit tests pass.
Confirm (grep is not verification; rely on tests) via the client.test.ts assertions that the token model and restart-overlimit disjointness behave as specified.
findings:
VERIFIED: npm run build + npm run typecheck => 0 tsc strict errors; npm test => 87 pass / 0 fail (58 FEAT-001 + 29 FEAT-002: mapper 23 incl. flat+nested packet layouts, process:exception, collision warnOnce; client token model incl. one-token-per-instance, FIFO, expiry, restart-suppression tagged intentional:true, crash-loop restart intentional:false increments ring, restart-overlimit crash does NOT increment restart ring). PM2 daemon NOT started (pgrep confirms none). pm2 package imported in exactly ONE place: src/pm2/client.ts createPm2Adapter() via dynamic `await import('pm2')`.

NEW FILES: src/pm2/mapper.ts, src/pm2/mapper.test.ts, src/pm2/client.ts, src/pm2/client.test.ts. src/index.ts left as the FEAT-001 stub (no Pm2Client wiring yet — that is FEAT-004).

mapper.ts EXPORTS (pure, no I/O, no pm2 import):
- RawProcess / RawPm2Env / RawPm2Monit: locally-modeled raw pm2.list/describe record shape (the installed pm2 typings omit runtime fields like exec_mode/kill_timeout on pm2_env, so the mapper models them itself and reads defensively).
- mapProcess(raw: RawProcess, now?): ProcessSnapshot — maps ONE record. instances from pm2_env.instances (clamped >=1); uptimeMs = now-pm_uptime only when status==='online' else null; mode via exec_mode.startsWith('cluster'); status via toProcStatus (unknown strings => 'unknown').
- aggregateList(list, logger?, now?): ProcessSnapshot[] — the per-NAME aggregate. Groups by name; instances = RECORD COUNT (NOT pm2_env.instances); cpu/memory SUMMED across records; pmId/pid/other from the primary = lowest pm_id. Logs warnOnce('name-collision:<name>') when a name has >1 record. IMPORTANT for callers/tests: a cluster of N instances appears as N separate list records sharing one name; a single record with pm2_env.instances=N still aggregates to instances=1.
- toProcStatus(raw): ProcStatus.
- normalizeEventName(packet): string|null  (field-path defense: packet.event ?? packet.data?.event).
- normalizeProc(packet): {name,pmId}|null  (packet.process ?? packet.data?.process; null if no name).
- normalizeException(data): {message,stack}  (data.stack ?? data.message ?? String(data)).
- type Pm2LifecycleEvent, interface NormalizedProc.

client.ts EXPORTS:
- class Pm2Client — the design interface: start(), stop(), isConnected(), list(), describe(name), control(action,name), startNew(opts), readLogsTail(name,lines,opts). ControlAction = 'start'|'stop'|'restart'|'reload'|'delete'. ControlResult = {ok:true,process} | {ok:false,code,message}. control() short-circuits to {ok:false,code:'PM2_UNAVAILABLE'} when !connected (never throws); a pm2-side control error yields {ok:false,code:'PM2_ERROR'}. control('start') starts a stopped process (adapter.startScript by name); startNew() registers a brand-new one and pushes NO token.
- interface Pm2Adapter (callback-style surface over pm2) + interface Pm2Bus (on/off?/close?) + type AdapterCallback<T>. This is the injectable seam: tests pass a fake adapter+bus, so no real daemon is ever needed. createPm2Adapter(): Promise<Pm2Adapter> is the ONLY pm2 import site (dynamic import, pm2.delete mapped to adapter.del).
- interface IntentionToken {kind:'stop'|'restart'|'delete', expiresAt}.
- interface Pm2ClientOptions {adapter, state (MonitorState), events (MonitorEvents), logger, sampleSec, graceMs, now?, setTimer?, clearTimer?}. FEAT-004 bootstrap must pass sampleSec=config.METRICS_SAMPLE_SEC and graceMs=config.INTENTIONAL_ACTION_GRACE_MS; the kill_timeout add-on is learned lazily from describe() and cached per name.
- interface StartNewOpts {script?,ecosystem?,name?,instances?,exec_mode?}, interface LogTailOpts {stream?,q?,level?}.

BEHAVIOR NOTES later features rely on:
- Connection: start() is non-blocking fire-and-forget; on connect success -> state.setConnected(true), initial list()->applyPm2List, launchBus, start the single metrics setInterval. On connect failure or bus error/close -> exponential backoff (1s,2s,4s... cap 30s, +/-20% jitter) retrying forever; first failure warn then debug; keeps pm2Connected=false. Reconnect re-lists, re-attaches bus, flips connected true.
- Bus channels subscribed: process:event, process:exception, log:err, log:out. Translation: online/start=>transition online (no error); restart=>transition online + error:captured level 'restart' (intentional:true iff a restart token was consumed, else false); 'restart overlimit'=>transition errored + error:captured level 'crash' (drives errored ONLY, does NOT touch the restart ring — MEDIUM-3); exit=>error:captured level 'crash' ONLY if no token consumed; stop=>transition stopped (token consumed if present); delete=>removed from snapshot (applyPm2List minus that name); process:exception=>error:captured level 'crash' with normalized message/stack; log:err=>per non-empty line log:line level 'error' AND error:captured level 'error'; log:out=>per non-empty line log:line level 'info' (never an error). Malformed packets (no event/proc after defensive read) are skipped with warnOnce('bus-malformed').
- error:captured events are emitted with signature:'' — the ErrorTracker recomputes the signature from processName+sample (confirmed against FEAT-001 tracker.handle). intentional is only set for restart-level events.
- Token model: per-name FIFO queue. control pushes one token per running instance (snapshot.instances, fallback 1): stop=>N stop, delete=>N delete, restart/reload=>N restart, start/startNew=>none. expiresAt = now + graceMs + (kill_timeout from describe when known). A PM2 exit/stop/restart event drops expired front tokens then consumes exactly one non-expired FIFO token; a consumed 'restart' token tags the emitted restart error intentional:true. 30s janitor timer sweeps expired tokens.
- Metrics loop: a single self-rescheduling setInterval(METRICS_SAMPLE_SEC) started once on first connect, cleared on stop(). Each tick list()->applyPm2List->emit exactly one metrics:tick(ProcessSnapshot[]). Transient list() error skips the tick (debug log, keeps last samples). This is the ONLY metrics timer in the app.
- readLogsTail(name,lines,opts): clamps lines to <=2000, resolves pm_out/pm_err_log_path via describe, bounded end-of-file read (grows the window until enough newlines), tags err-file lines 'error'/out-file 'info', merges+sorts by embedded/estimated ts for stream='all', then applies level filter then q filter (case-insensitive substring; /regex/ form -> RegExp, 'i' forced). Missing/unreadable file => [] (warnOnce). Returns LogLine[] (whole-history search out of scope by design).

TEST INFRA: client.test.ts injects a FakeAdapter + FakeBus (resolve via queueMicrotask) and no-op setTimer/clearTimer + an injected clock, so no real pm2/daemon and no real timers run. A connect(client) helper starts the client and flushes microtasks so the bus is attached before packets are emitted. The 'start/connect flips connected' test overrides adapter.listResult.

TEST SCRIPT CAVEAT (inherited from FEAT-001): package.json test is unquoted `tsx --test src/**/*.test.ts`; sh (no globstar) expands ** as * i.e. src/<dir>/*.test.ts, which matches src/pm2/*.test.ts fine since tests live exactly one dir deep.
